findings.source_quote:
City of God, how broad and far
outspread thy walls sublime!
findings.suggested_fix:
Adjust wording to a more natural Dutch idiom that preserves the meaning and poetic sense. For example: "Stad van God, hoe breed en wijd
spreiden zich uw muren, hoog en subliem!" This keeps the image of the walls being outspread and retains the adjective 'sublime' (subliem). Preserve existing HTML tags and line breaks.
findings.translation_quote:
Stad van God, hoe breed en wijd
ligt uit uw muren, hoog en groot!
